# Saved Massive HTTP samples

The dated directory contains four small real daily-aggregate responses, KALV and XBI, requested for 2025-07-01 through 2025-07-10 with adjusted=false and adjusted=true. `manifest.json` records the exact download timestamps, keyless URLs and SHA-256 checksums. These files test response parsing and primary-source rereading. They do not establish full census coverage, split-event behavior, the four-comparable acceptance, or live IBKR behavior. Split-event and error cases in the tests are explicitly synthetic. No key or authorization header is saved.
